author: Willu2101
body:
Hello,
I am contacting u to say my account Willu2101 has been banned for no reason I was falling and left the game by accident and it said I was banned is there anyway I can have help sorting this out

title: Getting Banned

replies.author: FrostedCupcakez
replies.body:
Hello Willu2101,

This evidence for your ban can be found here: https://youtu.be/p7Afrqw5wFI
The staff team will continue to review this evidence, and we'll get back to you.

Thank you for your appeal.

Sincerely, 
FrostedCupcakez

replies.body:
Willu,

The staff have determined that the evidence is sufficient for your ban, and you were hacking. Consider appealing in about 6 months.

Your appeal has been denied.
